assessor: RTS governed build assessment — Bounded Probe Executor v1
rationale: F already owns bounded probe planning and profile synthesis. G adds only a repository-local execution-control layer: deterministic campaign compilation, fingerprint-bound human approval, bounded parallel adapter execution, resumable checkpoints, sanitized observations, engine-drift stop, and review-only profile artifacts. Provider-specific network code and credentials remain out of scope.

assets.notes: Reuse engine/config/observation validation and bounded probe plan contract.
Reuse bounded execution and authority-separation patterns.
Reuse preview-before-application and rollback artifact pattern.

gaps: No current component compiles F probe plans into cost/retry-aware background campaigns.
No current component binds profile application to same-engine STABLE evidence plus a fingerprinted human approval artifact.

risks: Parallel probing can create spend bursts.
Retries can exceed a naive pre-run cost estimate.
Interrupted workers can rerun already completed jobs.
Provider/model identity can drift during a campaign.
Adapter results can smuggle raw prompt/response or hidden reasoning.
Profile recommendation can be mistaken for runtime authority.
